T (transformation): bhookhe students, jinhe lunch break mein khaana chahiye → students jinhe time par saaf, affordable khaana mil gaya.
W (worldview): 'achha canteen padhai ke din ka zaroori hissa hai, sirf ek business nahi.'
O (owners, jo system ko rok ya badal sakte hain): institute management.
E (environmental constraints): fixed lunch break, food safety rules, limited kitchen space, contractor ka margin.
Doosre worldview (jaise contractor ka 'canteen ek business hai') se doosri root definition banegi; SSM in dono ko compare karke aisi changes dhoondhta hai jo sab ke liye feasible aur desirable hon.
Answer: CATWOE se **alag worldviews saaf ho jaate hain**, jisse agreed improvements par baat ho sakti hai.

mistakes: Hegelian aur Kantian ko same samajhna. Kantian mein kai complementary models fit ke liye compare hote hain; Hegelian mein do **opposing** views jaan-boojh kar takraaye jaate hain.
Har problem par hard systems approach lagaana. Jab stakeholders goal par hi agree nahi hain, to optimisation se pehle soft approach se problem samajhna padta hai.
CATWOE mein 'W' ko workers samajhna. W = Weltanschauung, yaani woh worldview jisse transformation meaningful lagta hai; workers actors (A) hain.
revision: Leibnizian: logic se, internal consistency.
Lockean: data aur community ka consensus.
Kantian: kai models, best fit.
Hegelian: thesis vs antithesis → synthesis.
Singerian: open-ended, sweep in ethics aur naye variables.
Hard = clear goal, optimise; soft = messy, multiple worldviews (SSM, CATWOE). Ackoff: absolve, resolve, solve, dissolve.

questions.question: Ek strategy team same market data se do jaan-boojh kar opposing plans banati hai ('aggressive expansion' vs 'consolidation'), unka structured debate karwaati hai, aur debate se nikli insights se ek naya combined plan banaati hai. Churchman ke hisaab se ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Same data se thesis aur antithesis banakar takraana aur synthesis nikaalna Hegelian (dialectical) inquiry hai. Kantian trap hai: usme bhi kai models hote hain, par woh complementary hote hain aur best fit ke liye compare hote hain, jaan-boojh kar opposing nahi.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi situation hard systems approach ke liye sabse suitable hai?
options: Fixed routes aur known demand ke saath delivery cost minimise karna
Shehar ki development priorities par stakeholders ke beech jhagda suljhaana
Ek university ka culture redesign karna
Ek hospital ka purpose kya ho, is par disagreement
questions.explanation: Hard systems approach tab kaam karta hai jab goal clear aur agreed ho aur problem well-defined ho; delivery cost minimise karna ek classic optimisation problem hai. Baaki teeno mein stakeholders ke goals aur worldviews hi alag hain, jo soft systems approach ka area hai.

questions.question: Checkland ki soft systems methodology mein CATWOE ka 'W' kya hai?
options: Weltanschauung: woh worldview jisse transformation meaningful lagta hai
Wastage jo process mein hoti hai
questions.explanation: W = Weltanschauung (German shabd, matlab worldview): woh perspective jisme ye transformation sense banata hai. Alag worldviews se alag root definitions bante hain, aur SSM inhi ko compare karta hai. Workers trap hai, kyunki jo log transformation karte hain woh 'A' (actors) mein aate hain.

questions.question: Ek marketing team 2,000 customers ka survey karti hai aur jis baat par data aur poori team agree karti hai, use 'customer ki asli pasand' maan leti hai. Ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Observations (survey data) se shuru karna aur community ke consensus ko 'sach' maanna Lockean inquiry hai. Leibnizian trap hai kyunki dono 'systematic' lagte hain, par Leibnizian data se nahi, assumptions aur logic se conclusion nikaalta hai.

questions.question: Ek factory canteen mein dopahar 1 baje bahut bheed hoti hai. Ackoff ke chaar tareekon mein se kaunsa option problem ko 'dissolve' karna hai?
options: Kuch na karna aur ummeed karna ki bheed apne aap kam ho jaayegi
Pichhli baar ki tarah ek extra counter khol dena
Queueing model se counters ki optimal sankhya nikaalna
Departments ke lunch timings stagger kar dena taaki bheed bane hi nahi
questions.explanation: Dissolve ka matlab system ko aise redesign karna ki problem paida hi na ho; staggered lunch timings se 1 baje ki peak hi khatam ho jaati hai. Kuch na karna absolve hai, experience se extra counter resolve hai, aur queueing model se optimum nikaalna solve hai. Trap: solve, kyunki woh sabse 'scientific' lagta hai, par woh bheed ko accept karke usse deal karta hai.

questions.question: Ek forecasting team agle saal ki demand ke liye teen alag models banati hai (time-series trend, GDP par regression, aur expert panel), teeno ko same past data par test karti hai, aur woh model chunti hai jo data ko sabse achhe se explain kare. Ye kaunsa inquiring system hai?
questions.explanation: Same problem ke kai alternative models banana aur unme se best fit chunna Kantian inquiry hai, jo theory aur data dono ko saath laati hai. Hegelian sabse tempting trap hai, par usme views jaan-boojh kar opposing hote hain aur debate se synthesis banta hai; yahan models compete karte hain, takraate nahi. Lockean sirf data aur consensus par chalta, alag theories par nahi.

weeks.title: Integrative Management: Strategy, Structure, Culture and Responsibility
weeks.summary: Is week aap seekhoge ki strategy, structure aur culture ko ek saath fit kaise karte hain (Porter, Chandler, Schein, McKinsey 7S), change kaise manage hota hai, aur business ethics, CSR (India ka Section 135) aur sustainability ka role kya hai.
concepts: **Strategy**: Long-term direction aur competitive advantage paane ka plan. Levels: **corporate** (kaunse businesses mein rahein), **business** (ek market mein kaise compete karein) aur **functional** (marketing, operations jaise departments ka plan). Michael Porter ki **generic strategies**: **cost leadership** (industry mein sabse kam cost), **differentiation** (kuch unique jiske liye customer zyada de) aur **focus** (ek narrow segment par cost ya differentiation). Bina clear choice ke company 'stuck in the middle' ho sakti hai.

**Structure follows strategy**: Alfred Chandler ne 'Strategy and Structure' (1962) mein bade American firms ko study karke dikhaya ki jab strategy badalti hai (jaise diversification), tab structure ko bhi badalna padta hai. Ek product wali company ke liye **functional** structure theek hai; kai products ya regions wali company ke liye **divisional**; dono dimensions ek saath manage karne ke liye **matrix** (jisme unity of command tootta hai).

**Organisational culture (Edgar Schein)**: Teen levels: **artifacts** (dikhne wali cheezein: office layout, dress code, rituals), **espoused values** (jo company kehti hai ki woh maanti hai: mission statements, stated values) aur **basic underlying assumptions** (gehri, unspoken beliefs jo asli behaviour chalaati hain). Culture badalna mushkil hai kyunki asli culture sabse neeche wale level mein hota hai.

**McKinsey 7S framework**: Saat elements jo aapas mein fit hone chahiye: hard S (strategy, structure, systems) aur soft S (shared values, style, staff, skills); shared values centre mein. Strategy badlo par systems (incentives, processes) aur style (leadership) purane rahein to strategy fail hoti hai.

**Managing change**: Kurt Lewin ka model: **unfreeze** (change ki zaroorat samjhao, purani aadatein dheeli karo), **change** (naye tareeke laao, training, support) aur **refreeze** (naye behaviour ko systems, rewards aur norms se pakka karo). Resistance aam baat hai; communication aur participation se kam hota hai.

**Business ethics**: Decisions ko sirf 'legal hai?' se nahi, 'sahi hai?' se bhi judge karna. Approaches: **utilitarian** (sabse zyada logon ka sabse zyada fayda), **rights** (har insaan ke basic rights ka respect) aur **justice** (fair aur barabar treatment). Code of conduct, ethics training aur whistleblower protection ethical culture banaate hain.

**CSR**: Archie Carroll ka **CSR pyramid**: economic (profitable hona), legal (kaanoon maanna), ethical (kaanoon se aage jaakar sahi aur fair karna) aur philanthropic (community ke liye voluntary contribution). India mein Companies Act, 2013 ka **Section 135**: jin companies ki net worth ₹500 crore ya zyada, ya turnover ₹1,000 crore ya zyada, ya net profit ₹5 crore ya zyada ho, unhe pichhle 3 financial years ke average net profit ka kam se kam 2% CSR par kharch karna hota hai.

**Sustainability**: John Elkington ka **triple bottom line**: people, planet, profit; performance teeno par naapo. Aaj investors **ESG** (environmental, social, governance) metrics dekhte hain. Idea: long-term value tab banti hai jab business society aur environment ki keemat par nahi, unke saath grow kare.

example.problem: 'Godavari Cements' (fictional) Section 135 ke under aati hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹120 crore, ₹150 crore aur ₹180 crore tha. Is saal kam se kam kitna CSR kharch zaroori hai?
steps: Rule: pichhle 3 financial years ke average net profit ka 2%.
Average = 450 ÷ 3 = ₹150 crore.
Common galti: sirf latest year (180) ka 2% = ₹3.6 crore lena, ya teeno ke total ka 2% = ₹9 crore.
Answer: Kam se kam **₹3 crore** CSR par kharch karna hoga.

mistakes: Ethical aur philanthropic responsibility mix karna. Ethical = apne business ko fair tareeke se chalaana, chahe kaanoon na maange (jaise poori product information dena). Philanthropic = voluntary daan aur community programmes (jaise school banwaana).
Ye maanna ki nayi strategy announce karna kaafi hai. 7S ke hisaab se structure, systems, style aur skills bhi fit na hon to strategy kaagaz par reh jaati hai.
CSR ka 2% latest year ke profit par lagaana. Base pichhle teen years ka average net profit hai.
revision: Porter: cost leadership, differentiation, focus.
Chandler: structure follows strategy.
Schein: artifacts, espoused values, basic assumptions.
7S: strategy, structure, systems, shared values, style, staff, skills.
Lewin: unfreeze, change, refreeze.
Carroll: economic, legal, ethical, philanthropic. Section 135: average net profit (3 years) ka 2%.

questions.question: 'UdaanSasta Air' (fictional) sirf ek type ka aircraft use karti hai, free meals nahi deti, tickets sirf online bechti hai aur planes ka turnaround time kam rakhti hai, taaki fares industry mein sabse kam hon. Porter ke hisaab se ye kaunsi strategy hai?
questions.explanation: Har activity ko sabse kam cost ke liye design karna aur broad market ko sabse sasta offer dena cost leadership hai. Differentiation mein customer kisi unique feature ke liye zyada price deta, jo yahan nahi hai. Focus tab hota jab airline sirf ek narrow segment ko target karti.

questions.question: Ek startup ka open-plan office, bean bags, casual dress code aur Friday team lunches Schein ke model mein culture ke kis level par hain?
questions.explanation: Jo cheezein aankh se dikhti hain (layout, dress code, rituals) woh artifacts hain, culture ka sabse upari level. Inka matlab samajhne ke liye gehre levels dekhne padte hain. Espoused values trap hai: woh likhe ya bole gaye values hain (jaise 'we value openness'), physical cheezein nahi.

questions.question: Ek company Section 135 ke under aati hai. Pichhle teen financial years mein uska net profit ₹40 crore, ₹50 crore aur ₹90 crore tha. Is saal kam se kam kitna CSR kharch zaroori hai?
questions.explanation: Average net profit = (40 + 50 + 90) ÷ 3 = 180 ÷ 3 = ₹60 crore. CSR = 2% × 60 = ₹1.2 crore. ₹1.8 crore latest year (90) ka 2% hai, ₹3.6 crore teeno ke total (180) ka 2%, aur ₹1 crore beech wale year (50) ka 2%.

questions.question: 'Triveni Group' (fictional) pehle sirf soap banaati thi aur functional structure (ek production head, ek marketing head) mein chalti thi. Ab woh FMCG, hotels aur IT services mein diversify ho gayi hai aur decisions bahut slow ho gaye hain. Chandler kya suggest karte?
options: Functional structure hi rakho, kyunki structure kabhi nahi badalna chahiye
Divisional structure apnao, kyunki structure ko nayi strategy ke hisaab se badalna chahiye
Strategy ko purane structure ke hisaab se badlo
Saare decisions CEO ke paas centralise kar do
questions.explanation: Chandler ka finding tha ki structure strategy ko follow karta hai: diversification ke baad har business ke liye alag division (apne production, marketing ke saath) zyada effective hota hai. Teesra option relationship ko ulta kar deta hai, aur centralisation slow decisions ko aur slow karega.

questions.question: Ek bank nayi strategy announce karta hai: 'customer-centric innovation'. Par approvals ke liye ab bhi 7 signatures chahiye, managers ke bonus sirf cost-cutting par milte hain, aur top leadership ka style command-and-control hai. McKinsey 7S ke hisaab se diagnosis kya hai?
options: Sirf strategy matter karti hai, isliye sab theek hai
Misfit hai: systems, style aur shared values nayi strategy ko support nahi karte
Problem sirf staff ki sankhya ki hai
7S sirf chhoti companies par lagta hai
questions.explanation: 7S kehta hai ki saat elements ek doosre se fit hone chahiye. Approval process aur bonus systems hain, command style 'style' hai, aur ye teeno innovation ke khilaaf kaam kar rahe hain. Strategy akeli kaagaz par badli hai, isliye result nahi aayega. Staff count ka yahan koi zikr hi nahi.

questions.question: Ek pharma company saare pollution aur drug laws follow karti hai. Iske alawa woh apni dawa ke saare side-effect data publicly share karti hai, jabki kaanoon itna nahi maangta, kyunki patients ke saath ye fair hai. Carroll ke pyramid mein ye extra kadam kis level par hai?
questions.explanation: Kaanoon se aage jaakar apne core business ko fair aur sahi tareeke se chalaana ethical responsibility hai. Laws follow karna legal level hai, jo company pehle se kar rahi hai. Philanthropic sabse tempting trap hai, par woh voluntary daan aur community programmes (jaise hospital ko donation) ke baare mein hai, apne product ki honest jaankari dene ke baare mein nahi.

weeks.title: Revision: Applying the Whole Course to Mixed Cases
weeks.summary: Is week aap poore course ko ek saath revise karoge: case padh kar sahi thinker, school, function, tool, bias, archetype ya inquiry approach kaise pehchaanein, aur exam ke common traps se kaise bachein.
concepts: **Course map**: Business aur stakeholders (kiske liye manage karte hain) → management thought ka history (kaise soch evolve hui) → management aur business functions (manager kya karta hai, kahan karta hai) → thinking aur tools (achha sochna kaise) → systems thinking (jude hue problems kaise dekhein) → inquiring systems aur soft approaches (sach kaise tay karein) → integration (strategy, structure, culture, ethics).

**Classical aur behavioural clues**: 'Stopwatch, one best way, piece rate' → Taylor. 'Ek boss, scalar chain, 14 principles' → Fayol. 'Written rules, hierarchy, merit, impersonal' → Weber. 'Attention, informal group, social needs' → Mayo/Hawthorne. 'Log kaam se bachte hain vs self-direction' → McGregor. 'Good enough, limited information' → Simon. 'It depends' → contingency. 'Inputs, transformation, outputs, feedback' → systems approach.

**Management function vs business function**: Planning, organising, staffing, leading, controlling **management functions** hain jo har department mein hote hain. Operations, marketing, finance, HR, IS **business (functional) areas** hain. Sawaal mein 'kaunsa kaam' vs 'kaunsa department' ka fark pakdo.

**Bias aur tool clues**: Pehla number → anchoring. Sirf apne favour ka data → confirmation. 'Itna lag chuka hai' → sunk cost. Same fact alag shabdon mein → framing. Group mein koi doubt nahi bolta → groupthink. Root cause chahiye → five whys ya fishbone. Kai causes mein priority → Pareto. Internal vs external → SWOT. Meeting mein ek tarah ki soch → six hats. Existing product badalna → SCAMPER.

**Systems clues**: 'Growth phir achanak ruk gayi' → limits to growth. 'Quick fix baar-baar, asli solution kamzor' → shifting the burden. 'Fix ne baad mein problem badha di' → fixes that fail. 'Shared resource, sab apna fayda' → tragedy of the commons. 'Ek doosre ko jawab' → escalation. 'Goal neeche karte gaye' → eroding goals. 'Upar-neeche jhoolna' → balancing loop with delay. Loop type: negative links gino.

**Inquiry aur approach clues**: Logic/model se → Leibnizian. Data aur consensus → Lockean. Kai models, best fit → Kantian. Opposing plans ka debate → Hegelian. Open-ended, ethics sweep in → Singerian. Clear goal, optimise → hard systems. Conflicting worldviews, messy → soft systems (rich picture, CATWOE). Problem hi khatam karne wala redesign → Ackoff ka dissolve.

**Integration clues**: Sabse sasta → cost leadership; unique → differentiation; narrow segment → focus. Diversification ke baad structure badla → Chandler. Office layout/dress → artifacts. Strategy badli par systems/style nahi → 7S misfit. Kaanoon se aage fair business → ethical; daan → philanthropic. CSR = 3 saal ke average net profit ka 2%.

example.problem: 'Annapurna Foods' (fictional) ka case: (1) naye CEO ne har line par stopwatch se time study karwaayi; (2) packing team ne apna informal output limit rakha taaki koi 'rate-buster' na bane; (3) sales giri to har mahine discount diya gaya, recipe improvement ruk gaya; (4) board ne kaha 'is plant par ₹50 crore lag chuke, isliye band nahi kar sakte'; (5) farmers, NGOs aur company mein ek nayi sourcing policy par bilkul alag views hain. Har point ko course ke concept se jodo.
steps: (1) Time study aur one best way: Taylor ka **scientific management**.
(2) Informal group norm se output cap: **Hawthorne studies** (bank wiring room) ka finding.
(3) Quick fix (discount) se fundamental solution (product improve) kamzor hua: **shifting the burden** archetype.
(4) Past kharch ko future decision ka reason banana: **sunk cost fallacy**; sahi sawaal: 'aage ke costs aur benefits kya hain?'
(5) Conflicting worldviews wali messy situation: **soft systems methodology** (rich picture, alag root definitions with CATWOE), ya opposing proposals ke saath **Hegelian** debate.
Answer: Ek hi company mein classical, behavioural, systems, thinking aur inquiry, **paanchon lenses** ki zaroorat padti hai; course ka core yahi hai ki sahi situation par sahi lens lagao.

mistakes: Keyword dekh kar turant answer chun lena. 'Rules' word ho to har baar Weber nahi; poocho ki sawaal structure ke baare mein hai ya kisi ek boss ke baare mein (Fayol) ya situation ke hisaab se design (contingency).
Archetypes mein sirf kahani ka pehla hissa dekhna. Pura pattern dekho: kya koi fundamental solution kamzor hua (shifting the burden) ya fix ne khud problem waapas laayi (fixes that fail)?
Har problem ko optimisation ki tarah treat karna. Pehle poocho: kya goal par sab agree karte hain? Nahi, to soft approach.
revision: Taylor = efficiency; Fayol = administration; Weber = structure; Mayo = social factors.
Management functions har department mein; business functions departments hain.
Sunk cost ignore karo; anchoring se pehle apna estimate banao.
Loop type: negative links even = R, odd = B.
Hard = clear goal; soft = conflicting worldviews.
Strategy, structure, culture aur ethics ek saath fit hone chahiye.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa thinker aur idea ka pair sahi hai?
options: Fayol: scientific management aur time study
questions.explanation: Differential piece-rate Taylor ke scientific management ka hissa hai. Hawthorne studies Mayo se jude hain, 14 principles Fayol ke hain, aur scientific management Taylor ka hai. Baaki teeno options mein naam aur idea aapas mein swap kiye gaye hain, jo exam ka common trap hai.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa ek business (functional) area hai, management function nahi?
questions.explanation: Marketing ek functional area (department) hai. Planning, organising aur controlling management functions hain jo marketing, finance, HR, sab departments ke andar hote hain. Trap: 'function' shabd dono jagah aata hai, isliye dhyaan do ki sawaal 'kaam' ka hai ya 'area' ka.

questions.question: Ek factory supervisor daily target poora karne par bonus deta hai, par dekhta hai ki workers ka group khud ek output limit maanta hai aur usse zyada karne waale ko taane maarta hai. Kis research ne pehli baar is tarah ke informal group norms ko highlight kiya?
options: Hawthorne studies ka bank wiring room observation
questions.explanation: Hawthorne studies ke bank wiring room mein researchers ne dekha ki group ne khud output norm bana rakha tha aur incentive ke bawajood log usse zyada nahi karte the. Taylor trap hai, kyunki Taylor ne bhi workers ke jaan-boojh kar dheere kaam karne (soldiering) ki baat ki thi, par unka jawab time study aur piece-rate tha, social group ka analysis nahi.

questions.question: Ek shehar mein jab bhi accidents badhte hain, extra traffic police tainaat kar di jaati hai. Kuch time accidents kam hote hain, phir badhte hain, aur road design sudhaarne ka budget har saal kat-ta jaata hai kyunki 'police se kaam chal raha hai'. Kaunsa archetype hai?
questions.explanation: Extra police symptomatic quick fix hai aur road redesign fundamental solution. Quick fix par bharosa badhne se fundamental solution ka budget kat-ta gaya: ye shifting the burden hai. Road shared hai isliye tragedy of the commons tempting lagta hai, par yahan resource ka overuse nahi, quick fix par dependence ki kahani hai.

questions.question: Board meeting mein CFO kehta hai: 'Is plant par ₹50 crore lag chuke hain, isliye ise poora karna hi padega.' Ek director poochti hai: 'Agar hum aaj zero se shuru karte, to kya agle ₹30 crore yahin lagaate?' Director kis bias se bacha rahi hai?
questions.explanation: Director ka sawaal ₹50 crore (jo wapas nahi aa sakta) ko hata kar sirf future ₹30 crore aur unke benefits par decision le jaata hai, jo sunk cost fallacy ka seedha ilaaj hai. Anchoring trap hai kyunki ₹50 crore ek bada number hai, par CFO ka argument number se estimate kheenchne ka nahi, past kharch ko reason banane ka hai.

questions.question: Ek state government parali (stubble) burning kam karna chahti hai. Farmers, agricultural scientists, officials aur shehar ke log is issue ko bilkul alag tareeke se dekhte hain, aur kisi ek objective par agreement nahi hai. Course ke hisaab se sabse suitable approach kya hai?
options: Shuru mein hi ek single cost function ke saath hard systems optimisation
Farmers ke kaam ki Taylor-style time study
Sirf Weber-style strict rules aur penalties
Soft systems approach: rich picture aur alag worldviews ki root definitions (CATWOE) se situation samjho, phir feasible aur desirable changes par agree karo
questions.explanation: Jab stakeholders ke goals aur worldviews alag hon aur problem khud disputed ho, to ye messy, soft situation hai; SSM pehle alag perspectives saamne laata hai aur phir agreed changes dhoondhta hai. Hard optimisation sabse tempting trap hai, par usse pehle ek agreed objective chahiye jo yahan nahi hai. Sirf rules lagaana bhi un worldviews ko ignore karta hai jinki wajah se rules follow nahi hote.
